title: SG-7 Integrate the game screen, behaviours and responsive layout
summary: Game screen uses a 3/4 scene and 1/4 panel layout, a bottom drawer on narrow screens, interact animation, fade transitions and no placeholder styling
description: Context: header, 480x270 scene and story panel already exist, but GameLayout splits 4fr/1fr (80/20), App never emits playAnimation or transitionTo to Phaser, BootScene.transitionTo does not ignore empty or unknown scene ids, and styles.css still holds placeholder .contribution-sheet styling. Desired behaviour: the delivered game screen matches the SG-7 Done when. Expected result: layout, behaviours and styles are wired to the real entry point and unit tested. Why: the visual overhaul needs one integrated screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a wide viewport, when the game screen renders, then the grid is about three quarters scene and one quarter panel
Given a narrow viewport, when the Story button is clicked, then the panel drawer toggles via uiStore
Given a game action, when it runs, then playAnimation interact is emitted for the boy
Given a valid scene change, when state.currentScene changes, then transitionTo is emitted and the camera fades
Given an empty or unknown scene id, when transitionTo arrives, then the scene is ignored
Given styles.css, when read, then no placeholder styling remains

preserve: Go API contracts and contribution flow

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with passing unit tests
